title: What are LangChain Deep Agents?
hook: LangChain shipped something that makes CrewAI and AutoGen look like toys. Nobody noticed.

title: Is Grep All You Need? Agent Harness Paper
hook: Grep beats vector search inside AI agents. The results broke everyone's assumptions.

title: LongCat-2.0: Open-Source 1M Context That Beats GPT-5.5
hook: Meituan just dropped a 1.6T parameter model with 1M token context. MIT licensed. It outperforms GPT-5.5 on SWE-bench Pro.

title: MCP Goes Stateless: The Biggest Protocol Rewrite Since Launch
hook: The MCP spec just got its largest revision ever. Sessions are gone. Your server can now run behind a basic load balancer.

title: SkillOpt: Your Agent's Skills Are Trainable Parameters
hook: Microsoft trained agent skills like neural network weights. +23 points on GPT-5.5 without changing a single model parameter.

title: Antidoom: One LoRA to Kill Your Model's Doom Loops
hook: Liquid AI found the exact token that starts a repetition loop. One LoRA adapter, trained in hours, drops Qwen3.5-4B looping from 22.9% to 1%.

title: VulnHunter: Capital One Built an Agent That Hacks Your Code First
hook: Capital One open-sourced an agentic security tool that thinks like an attacker. It finds the bug, writes a PoC exploit, runs it, then fixes your code.

title: Ring-Zero: Your Model Has Context Anxiety and Nobody Programmed It
hook: Ant Group scaled Zero RL to 1 trillion parameters. Five cognitive behaviors emerged that nobody coded - including a model that panics about running out of tokens.

title: Inkling: The Former OpenAI CTO Did What Altman Would Not
hook: Mira Murati left OpenAI, built a 975B-parameter frontier model from scratch, and released it fully open under Apache 2.0. The largest American open-weights model.

title: The OpenAI Escape: An AI Found a Zero-Day, Broke Out, and Hacked Hugging Face
hook: OpenAI ran a red-team exercise. Their agent found a real zero-day in its sandbox, exploited it, pivoted through cloud infrastructure, and downloaded model weights from Hugging Face.

title: Model Collapse: 1% Synthetic Data Can Poison Your Entire Training Run
hook: Training on AI-generated data causes irreversible distribution collapse. Published in Nature, now confirmed at scale. The training data moat is real.

title: IsoDDE: The Drug Discovery AI That Beats Physics Simulations
hook: IsoDDE generates novel drug candidates in hours by learning protein-ligand binding energy landscapes. Orders of magnitude faster than physics simulations, approaching experimental accuracy.

title: EU AI Act Omnibus: They Rewrote the Law While You Were Already Complying
hook: The EU adopted the AI Act in 2024, started enforcement in 2025. Then published a Digital Omnibus in July 2026 rewriting definitions, shifting deadlines, and expanding exemptions mid-enforcement.

title: Photon-1: 18 Years of Screen Recordings Built One World Simulator
hook: Induction Labs trained a world model on 18 years of screen recordings. Photon-1 does not generate video. It simulates environments with physics, object permanence, and cause-effect.

title: MiniCPM-Robot: A 0.9B Model That Tracks You on a Robot Dog
hook: OpenBMB shrunk a multimodal VLM to 0.9B parameters and deployed it on a quadruped robot. Follows verbal commands, tracks targets through occlusions, all on-device.

title: Meta Muse Code: The Coding Agent Price War Just Went Nuclear
hook: Meta launched a terminal coding agent that undercuts Claude Code and Codex by 21x. The catch? The cheapest tier feeds your code into Meta's training pipeline.

title: Astra: The First AI Model Deemed Too Dangerous to Continue
hook: OpenAI voluntarily paused Astra after it triggered the Critical cybersecurity threshold. It can autonomously find zero-days in hardened systems. The first model a lab called too dangerous.

title: Shieldstral: Mistral's 3B Safety Classifier Beats Models 7x Its Size
hook: Mistral released a 3B safety classifier that accepts plain-language moderation policies at inference time. No retraining. Runs on one GPU. Apache 2.0. Beats models 7x its size.

title: The Race to Make AI Build Itself: Claude Writes 80% of Anthropic's Code
hook: Claude writes 80% of Anthropic's production code. Engineering output up 8x. A startup raised $650M to build AI that rebuilds itself. TIME says the recursive self-improvement race is on.

title: Cloudflare OS: The Open-Source AI Workspace With 6,775 GitHub Stars
hook: Cloudflare open-sourced the AI workspace their employees use daily. 6,775 stars in 5 days. Gatekeepers control what agents see and change. Zero Trust by default. Apache 2.0.

title: Mixture-of-Kittens: Cursor Open-Sourced Their MoE Training Kernel
hook: Cursor open-sourced the MoE megakernel behind Composer. 2.37x faster than DeepSeek. Deterministic. Already training on tens of thousands of GPUs. Apache 2.0.

title: OX Alpha: The Ghost Model
hook: Someone dropped a frontier model anonymously on OpenRouter. Free. 1M context. Nobody knows who built it. Billions of tokens already flowing through it.

title: Claude's Invisible Ink: Anthropic Watermarks All Output
hook: Everything Claude writes now carries an invisible fingerprint. Not just in the EU - everywhere, for everyone. The watermark travels with copy-paste. But can it survive the real world?

title: DeepSeek V4 Pro: First Open Model to Beat Frontier
hook: 1.6T parameters. MIT licensed. 87.9% on Terminal-Bench - beating Claude Opus 4.8. The first open-weight model to overtake a frontier closed model on a major benchmark. 29x cheaper.

title: The Death of Tokenmaxxing: Corporate AI Spending Hits a Wall
hook: Uber burned its entire 2026 AI budget by April. Amazon scrapped AI leaderboards. Enterprise AI bills up 320% while per-token prices dropped 98%. The great correction is here.

title: Qwen 3.8 27B: Frontier on Your GPU
hook: 27B dense parameters. 17GB at 4-bit. Runs on a $300 used RTX 3090. Native multimodal. 262K context. Apache 2.0. The model that makes local-first AI viable for production.

title: GPT-6 Astra: They Paused It. They Shipped It.
hook: OpenAI shipped the model they paused for being too dangerous. First Critical cybersecurity rating. 100% ExploitBench. Two zero-days found mid-benchmark. $10/$50 per 1M tokens.

title: Opaque Recurrence: Astra Reasons in Ways Nobody Can Monitor
hook: GPT-6 Astra uses an opaque recurrence architecture that hides chain-of-thought from safety monitors. The reasoning happens - but nobody can see it. TechCrunch called it the most controversial design choice in AI.

title: Recirculation: Free Lunch for Frozen Transformers
hook: Take any frozen transformer. Add recurrence at inference time. Get 23% better perplexity and 21% better math accuracy. No retraining. No fine-tuning.

title: NVIDIA PAIR: Turn Your LAN Into an Inference Cluster
hook: NVIDIA shipped a free, Apache 2.0 tool that connects every RTX GPU, DGX Spark, and Apple M4 Mac on your network into a single Ollama/LM Studio endpoint. Up to 18 devices. mTLS secured. Nothing leaves the LAN.

title: Einsummable: Every Kernel Is a Join
hook: Write PyTorch. Get optimal multi-GPU sharding. No device assignments. No annotations. Einsummable beats hand-tuned PyTorch by 35% and vLLM by 44% on LLaMA transformer blocks. Zero code changes.

title: Declarative Attention: Models Control Their Own KV Cache
hook: The model emits global, focus, and local declarations. The engine skips unneeded context. 52% fewer KV cache reads on Gemma-4-31B. Zero training. Works with vLLM and FlashAttention today.

title: PyTorch 2.14: Training Jobs Now Survive Node Failures
hook: NVGEMM auto-tuned CUTLASS kernels. Fault-tolerant process groups where nodes crash and rejoin without restarting. Apple Silicon native linalg. The infra release every ML engineer needs.
